desc:
JJ VS MIKEY PRISON RUN! (Obby)

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to support the game.

Complete 25 obstacle stages and make your way through the prison to escape.
Run, jump, and dodge tricky traps as you complete fun parkour challenges with smooth, easy-to-learn controls, choosing to play as JJ or Mikey from the Maizen world!

Play solo or with friends.
Improve your best time and view your results on the leaderboard.

Colorful obstacle gameplay designed to be family-friendly and fun for all ages, inspired by the Maizen YouTube channel.
